SOUTHERN ISLANDS LOCAL COUNCIL
(AMENDMENT) BILL


    "to amend the Southern Islands Local Council Ordinance, 1958 (No. 11 of 1958)",

presented by the Minister for Local Government, Lands and Housing (Dato Abdul Hamid Bin Haji Jumat); read the First time; to be read a Second time on Wednesday, 11th February, 1959, and to be printed.
